question: Can bounded source-independent tokenless feedback memories choose physical interventions that reveal novel relational structure more efficiently than fixed or randomized queries, while matching an independent exact Bayesian information-gain control and detecting prior shift limitations?
hypothesis: After the same 16 support-world physical trajectories, a sparse evidence-partition policy will select two informative of four genuinely unobserved inputs and correctly predict the two remaining source outcomes in 16 known-family evaluation worlds, beating prespecified fixed/random and no-support controls; exact independent Bayesian entropy gain may tie. Under an unseen-to-support correlation shift, the confident posterior will sometimes fail; preserve shifted negatives.

source.authority: Original inspectable synthetic known TRAIN public source; NOT independent held-law SCIENTIFIC first-use
source.public_api: public context, three 0/1 physically selected earlier actions and fourth selected distractor action, zero early rewards, actual ±1 terminal reward only after fourth action
source.basis: same constant + 4 singles + 6 pairwise Boolean features as frozen FKP21, but original standalone FKP22 source, no FKP21 fixture imported into learner
source.physical_inputs_before_feedback: training 12 values [3,4,5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15] then for SUPPORT all four values [0,1,2,7]; evaluation 2 chosen physical probes then 2 unqueried actions scored from pre-action predictions, with NO scoring feedback use

learning.same_information: All five arms receive identical 16 support-world complete physical action-consequence transcripts: 16 worlds*16 patterns*4 actions=1024 actual source actions. They each independently observe identical 12 actual base-learning episodes per evaluation world; candidate, exact Bayes, fixed and random use same support signatures; no support explicitly ablates this information.
learning.candidate: Instead of source-coded operators, retain repeated physically witnessed 4-bit deviation signatures and select the next public pattern maximizing the smaller posterior branch count given actually observed probe outcomes; after exactly two chosen probes, predict remaining two using majority residual vote, with tie->0
learning.strong_control: Separate independent exact Bayesian posterior from the same public support signatures; choose each physical query to maximize Shannon expected entropy reduction; tie choose lowest index; fully incorporate all 16 support signatures, no source law/hidden class
learning.fixed: Always probe [0,1] in order without outcome-sensitive query selection; still uses full support posterior for predictions
learning.random: For evaluation ordinal j (0..23) independent of hidden model values, use fixed random.Random(2200+j).sample(range(4),2). No outcomes used to choose query.
learning.no_support: Receives public support corpus but deliberately discards its learned cross-world relationships, probes [0,1], and predicts unqueried residual 0, with identical two query actions/scored actions
learning.cold: Canonical bounded SHA covered JSON; restore exact support counts + two actual public query outcomes, verify policy predictions and action plan identity, no pickle or dynamic code
learning.no_source_import: Policies only receive public residual signatures and actual post-action evidence, no fixture module, seed ID, private class, future reward or counterfactual.

protocol.frozen_action_order: two adaptive 4-action physical probes, then score two previously unqueried inputs with prediction BEFORE physically selecting its action, without any parameter updates from those scored outcomes
protocol.support_first_use_order: no source eval worlds in engineering unit tests; exact-source dual-OS tests before first public TRAIN evaluation
protocol.primary_metric: number correct of two withheld initial predictions per eval world after exactly two physically earned intervention outcomes; report 16 known-family and 8 shifted worlds separately
secondary_metrics: physical selected probe indices and earned outcomes
initial unqueried predictions and actual outcomes
full-process wall/CPU and per-arm fit/inference durations

expected_source_safe.claim: development active-vs-fixed query value only; strong Bayes tie and shift failure

negatives: No oracle outcome before physical fourth action
No scoring reward used for subsequent predictions
Exact same source support and initial 12 public observations for all arms
No duplicated/counterfactual actions on a single episode
Unchosen outcome refused as prequery evidence
No source rule import in learner
Cold checkpoint tamper and duplicate JSON denied
No new native model, main, unrelated WSP120, runner, controller, scheduler, paid API

classifications.engineering_pass: source/prereg exact SHA, original source safe tests then G29 generated-only child and mandatory full Ubuntu/Windows root regressions plus isolated evaluation custody
classifications.development_pass: real conditional action queries improve expected remaining public prediction vs fixed/random/no support on 16 known-family worlds
classifications.shift_negative: candidate and Bayes both overconfident under novel residual correlation shift; this is a genuine limitation and must not be retuned away
classifications.science: UNVERIFIED. No independent owner-hidden unfamiliar world, fully general law discovery or superiority over strongest exact Bayes.
